rg.about.title: About the demo
rg.about.p1: You stand in front of a machine. A lever, three reels, a number on the board. You pull, check the payout and count what is left to the quota.
rg.about.p2: The demo has one first trial. Whatever comes after is better seen for yourself.

dr.about.title: About the game
dr.about.p1: A pixel-art clicker about mining ore. You swing the pickaxe at the rock and chance decides what drops: plain coal or a rare crystal.
dr.about.p2: Every ore gets a rarity, purity, size and mutation. Sell your haul, grow the upgrade tree, open new mines. A small story starts out cozy and turns darker toward the end.
dr.f2: Seven places: a barn, a shop, a workshop and four mines
dr.f4: A collection of ores, mutations and artifacts
